NAME: Required document missing
DESCRIPTION: A document the scoping stream needs is not in the registry

NAME: Duplicate upload
DESCRIPTION: Same file hash registered twice for the site

NAME: Low-confidence extraction
DESCRIPTION: A field was read below the confidence threshold and needs human review

NAME: Stale structural or mount analysis
DESCRIPTION: SA/MA was run on an RFDS revision older than the current one

NAME: CD built on older RFDS
DESCRIPTION: CD general notes reference an older RFDS revision than the current one

NAME: MA/SA loading differs from RFDS
DESCRIPTION: Antenna or radio count/model in the analysed loading differs from the final RFDS

NAME: Mount modification not shown on CD
DESCRIPTION: MA requires a modification (e.g. reinforcement kit) that the CD does not show

NAME: Structure fails analysis
DESCRIPTION: SA controlling capacity above 100% - structural modification needed before install

NAME: Mount over capacity
DESCRIPTION: MA mount capacity above 100% for the proposed loading

NAME: Azimuth mismatch RFDS vs CD
DESCRIPTION: Sector azimuth on the RFDS differs from the CD

NAME: Equipment on RFDS missing from CD
DESCRIPTION: A proposed antenna/AAU/radio on the RFDS is not on the CD

NAME: Equipment on CD not on RFDS
DESCRIPTION: The CD shows proposed equipment the RFDS does not have

NAME: Position mismatch RFDS vs CD
DESCRIPTION: Same equipment placed at a different mounting position on the CD (swap)

NAME: RAD center mismatch RFDS vs CD
DESCRIPTION: RAD center differs between RFDS and CD

NAME: Model mismatch RFDS vs CD
DESCRIPTION: Different model at the same sector/position

NAME: Unrecorded equipment in field
DESCRIPTION: Drone survey finds equipment that neither the CD nor the RFDS records

NAME: Mount pipe missing in field
DESCRIPTION: CD shows an existing (spare) mount pipe that the drone survey does not find

NAME: RAD center differs in field
DESCRIPTION: Measured RAD center of existing antennas differs from the CD/RFDS beyond tolerance

NAME: Azimuth differs in field
DESCRIPTION: Measured sector azimuth differs from the CD/RFDS beyond tolerance

NAME: Roof sled missing in field
DESCRIPTION: CD shows an existing roof sled that the drone survey does not find

NAME: Cable route length differs
DESCRIPTION: Measured cabinet-to-structure route differs from the CD cable schedule beyond tolerance

NAME: Existing equipment not found in field
DESCRIPTION: CD shows existing equipment the drone survey does not find

NAME: Cable length undocumented
DESCRIPTION: No documented route length for a required trunk - never assume a length

NAME: REV 0 line missing
DESCRIPTION: A line the rules require is missing from REV 0

NAME: REV 0 quantity differs
DESCRIPTION: REV 0 quantity differs from what the rules produce

NAME: REV 0 duplicate line
DESCRIPTION: REV 0 lists the same item twice for the same sector

NAME: Non-approved part number
DESCRIPTION: REV 0 uses a part that is not customer approved

NAME: REV 0 extra line
DESCRIPTION: REV 0 carries a line the rules do not produce
